---
title: "How to use this site"
description: "A simple way to find the guidance you need."
---

Use the top navigation to answer practical questions:

- Start with [Start Here](../start/index.qmd) if you are joining, starting, or recovering work.
- Use [How GeoEpi organizes work](../organization/index.qmd) to place a project, subproject, or repository.
- Use [Data Management](../data/index.qmd) for project data stewardship and analysis-specific provenance.
- Use [Computing & Repositories](../compute/index.qmd) for GitHub, Atlas, Ceres, and run-level records.
- Use [Tools & Collaboration](../tools/index.qmd) for common GeoEpi tools.
- Copy a starting point from [Templates](../templates/index.qmd).
- Check [Resources](../resources/index.qmd) for external guidance.

Projects differ. Adapt the templates to the work, record important deviations, and link to the authoritative location of the information. Detailed scientific and domain guidance will be developed separately; the archived material is retained for that future work.
